title: Knowledge Boundary Map
user: A self-learner who has consumed a topic but needs to distinguish recognition from an explanation they can actually produce.
smallest_useful_product: Static web app with a node map: add a claim and prerequisites, do a 90-second teach-back, then mark ‘explain’, ‘recognize’, or ‘blocked’ with a next probe.
success_measure: At least 50% of activated users create five claims and revisit one previously overconfident claim within seven days.
constraints: Private-by-default browser storage; clearly label self-assessments; accessible diagram navigation; no claim of objectively measuring intelligence.
